name: Mani (prophet)
contribution: An Iranian prophet and the founder of Manichaeism, a religion most prevalent in late antiquity.

checks.lead: Mani (; c. April AD 216 – 2 March AD 274 or 26 February AD 277) was an Iranian prophet and the founder of Manichaeism, a religion most prevalent in late antiquity.
